description: Show only the projects you are working on by switching the sidebar between spaces such as Work and Personal. Each space has a name, an icon and its own projects; pick one from the menu in the sidebar header or press ⌃⌥1 to ⌃⌥9, and All projects shows everything again. Edit Spaces sets each space's projects, icon and order, and a project in no space stays visible in every space. `bb space` switches from a terminal or an agent. Needs bb 0.49 or later with the bundled Thread list plugin, and an active space groups the thread list by project.
